Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 20s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, voluminous curls teal hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries applied silver leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright cool silver sheen. Her bust carries a large snake eye on each breast, a glowing amber-green iris with a vertical black slit pupil whose centre fully and opaquely covers her nipple and areola, surrounded by fine glossy emerald scales forming a scaled eyelid ring with a sharp pointed corner at each end of the eye, the scales spreading outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied copper leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright warm copper sheen. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries applied rose-gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright rose-gold sheen. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries emerald-green high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy baby blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in baby blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
